EC1: - State of shock [AND] with unstable hemodynamics (PA <90/60)
EC2: - Suspected [OR] or proven trauma to the chest, [OR] abdomen [OR] or pelvis
EC5: - Patient who has already received analgesics (with the exception of paracetamol)
EC6: - Patient receiving an intravenous approach for analgesia
EC8: - Hypersensitivity to fluoridated anesthetics [OR] or history of malignant hyperthermia in the patient [OR] or family
EC11: - Non communicating patient [OR] or with difficulties of understanding
